# mtncloud_load_balancer_floating_ip_pools (Data Source)

Lists where a load balancer on an MTN Network can get a public IP: the floating IP pools, and the addresses your project already holds that aren't attached to anything.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network" "app" {
  name = "app-net"
}

data "mtncloud_load_balancer_floating_ip_pools" "app" {
  network_id = data.mtncloud_network.app.id
}

output "public_pools" {
  value = [for p in data.mtncloud_load_balancer_floating_ip_pools.app.pools : p.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own the network or have it shared with it.

### Read-Only

- `available_addresses` (Attributes List) Addresses the project holds that are free to attach, sorted by address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available_addresses))
- `pools` (Attributes List) Floating IP pools, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pools))

<a id="nestedatt--available_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `available_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The public IP.
- `id` (String) Floating IP ID.


<a id="nestedatt--pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pools`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Pool ID.
- `name` (String) Pool name, for example `public-network-01`.
